effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Greymon] in its name and 1 Digimon card with [Gabumon], [Garurumon] or [Omnimon] in its name among them to your hand. Place the rest on top of your deck in any order.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your other Digimon digivolves, gain 1 memory.
